per_ticket.description: Simple FAQ — auto-send (Gate 1 + Gate 2 pass, FAQ intent)
per_ticket.customer_message:
From: carol@example.com
Subject: How do I reset my password?

Hi, I can't log in and forgot my password. How do I reset it?
per_ticket.final_draft:
Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out! Resetting your password is quick and easy:

1. Go to the ACME login page and click "Forgot password?"
2. Enter the email address associated with your account.
3. Check your inbox for a reset link and follow the instructions to set a new password.

If the email doesn't arrive within a few minutes, be sure to check your spam or junk folder. And if you run into any trouble along the way, just reply here and we'll be happy to help.

Best,
The ACME Support team
